title: Stan Karwoski, Washington County Commissioner District 2

script:
This is the New Saint Croix Union. Wednesday's biography is Stan Karwoski, Washington County Commissioner District 2.

Stan Karwoski is a native of St. Paul. He has lived in Oakdale since nineteen eighty-seven. He graduated from Harding High School. He earned a design degree from a vocational school and a bachelor's degree in business administration from Metropolitan State University.

He worked for thirty-eight years at Graco, Inc., as a principal designer. He holds nine invention patents. He is retired from that work.

Before the county board he served four terms on the Oakdale City Council. He was elected mayor of Oakdale in two thousand fourteen. He held that post until his election to the county board.

He was first elected to the Washington County Board in a special election in November two thousand sixteen for District 2. He was reelected in two thousand eighteen and two thousand twenty-two. He was sworn in as the District 2 commissioner on December sixth, two thousand sixteen.

He has been active in civic organizations including the Oakdale, Woodbury, and St. Paul Chambers and the St. Paul Winter Carnival. He is a past president of the Independent School District six twenty-two Education Foundation. He is a past chairman of the Washington County Park and Open Space Commission. He has served with the Yellow Ribbon Network and on Oakdale’s planning and park commissions. He has volunteered as a student reading mentor and a robotics mentor.
